create_openai_text_to_speech_handler: create an OpenAITextToSpeechHandler instance to apply guardrails to text-to-speech input
apply_guardrail_to_input: apply guardrails to the input text parameter of an OpenAI text-to-speech request
process_input_messages: process input messages by applying a custom guardrail to the speech input text
process_output_response: process the binary audio output response without applying text guardrails
test_openai_text_to_speech_handler: test the OpenAITextToSpeechHandler with sample input text and a custom guardrail
